title: bridge_status.json
description: Written atomically (tmp + rename) every --stats-s seconds by pc/dante_bridge.py. `pps`, `loss_pct`, `blocks_all_zero_frac` describe the LAST stats interval; `pkts`, `gaps`, `backwards`, `bad`, `blocks`, `uptime_s` are cumulative since the process started. Producer: pc/dante_bridge.py. Consumers: pc/bma_cable_sink.py (data track kind 3), analysis/summarize.py, operators.

t.description: PC wall clock when written, Unix seconds (float).

group.description: multicast group:port the media socket is joined to (or the --bind address in test mode).

pps.description: Packets per second over the last interval (3000 per flow when healthy).

loss_pct.description: Percent of the last interval's frames lost, from the card's frame counter.

backwards.description: Cumulative count of packets whose counter went backwards.

bad.description: Cumulative count of malformed media packets.

blocks_all_zero_frac.description: Fraction of the last interval's blocks that were all zero.

state.description: NOPKT: no packet in the interval. UNFED: more than 99.9% of blocks all-zero (the card's Tx carries no audio). ok otherwise.

nch.description: Channels seen in the flow (8 for the beam flow).

channels.description: 1-based channels forwarded as slot 0 to the --to targets (the loudest one when --channels auto).

targets.description: Resolved --to targets only. The --all-to targets are NOT listed (see CHANGELOG known disagreements).
